tasks.short: Issue signed title commitments and policies.

steps.what: Read title information compiled from the searches.
Mark title information the searches compiled.
Prepare title commitments from that information.
Review title policies against the searches.
Sign the title commitments.
Issue the accepted title commitments and policies.

tasks.design: The examiner marks the title information and reviews the policies against the searches. A template then places only the exceptions they marked into the commitments. They sign that version. {EMAIL} issues the signed version. The draft does not add an exception. The system does not issue the policy.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same exceptions were retyped into the commitment after the search was already marked.
tasks.enabler_now: Marked exceptions can be placed into the commitment the office already uses.
tasks.still_hard: Which exception belongs, and whether the policy may go out, stay with the examiner after the search notes exist.
tasks.human_edge: The examiner signs. A template does not issue the policy.
tasks.altitude: Marking the information, reviewing the policies, and signing stay in full. Only opening the compiled search and issuing the signed version are shorter.

reach.task: Receive the commitments the examiner signed
reach.learn: The examiner still signs after the search notes exist

evidence.claim: Issuing a commitment or a policy is the examiner's decision. The examiner signs after the search notes exist. A system does not issue it.
Stated fields on a recorded document can be copied. A clause the fields do not hold is not invented.
Names and title documents are personal data. They leave only in a version the examiner has accepted.
Confidential title files are not pasted into a free tool. A copy uses only fields the examiner already marked.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a search file is compiled and ends when the signed commitments are issued. The examiner marks, reviews, and signs. Nothing issues a policy.

The fields are parcel id, search date, the exception the examiner marked, the commitment version, and the policy version. The search file produces the compiled notes. The examiner produces the exception and signs. If a note is missing, the commitment is not prepared. The issue is the signed version, not a new legal conclusion.

The prior classes this task as amplify and treats judgement, review, and a legal or financial error as the hard part. The steps agree: the examination and the signature stay. The open and the issue are the parts that move.
unknowns: Whether the office commitment template already holds every exception type they mark.
Who must receive the signed commitments besides the closing party.
research_questions: Does the commitment template already hold every exception type they mark?
Who must receive the signed commitments besides the closing party?

tasks.short: Examine documentation and file the accepted note.

steps.what: List mortgages, liens, and contracts on the parcel.
Examine easements, judgments, and agreements in the documentation.
Verify legal descriptions, ownership, and the books.
Accept the restrictions they verify.
File the documentation they examine.

tasks.design: The examiner examines the documentation and verifies the legal descriptions, ownership, and the books. {GOV_PORTAL} only lists mortgages, liens, and contracts the register already indexes. {DOCS} files the examination they accepted. The list does not examine the documents. A clause the index does not hold is not invented.
tasks.previous_blocker: The index rows were copied by hand before the examiner could read the documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Indexed instrument rows can be listed from the register the office already queries.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a restriction is real, and what the books show, stay with the examiner.
tasks.human_edge: The examiner verifies. An index row does not.
tasks.altitude: The examination and the verification stay in full. Only the index list and the filing of the accepted examination are shorter.

reach.task: See the examination the examiner accepted
reach.learn: The searcher does not verify the books

evidence.claim: A parcel query can list instruments the register already indexes. It does not examine them.
Stated fields on a recorded document can be copied. A clause the fields do not hold is not invented.
Names and title documents are personal data. They leave only in a version the examiner has accepted.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a parcel is named and ends when the accepted examination is on file. The examiner examines and verifies. The query does not.

The fields are document type, parties, date, amount, restriction, and the result they verify. The recorded instrument produces the indexed fields. The examiner produces the result. A document the index missed is added by the examiner.

tasks.short: Examine titles and file the accepted limit.

steps.what: Read delinquent taxes on the titles.
Examine individual titles for restrictions.
Determine whether restrictions affect the titles.
Accept the limit on property use.
File the accepted titles note.

tasks.design: The examiner examines the individual titles and determines whether the restrictions affect them and limit property use. {GOV_PORTAL} only shows delinquent taxes the tax roll already states. {DOCS} files the titles note they accepted. The tax row does not decide the limit.
tasks.previous_blocker: The tax figure was copied by hand before the examiner could read the title.
tasks.enabler_now: A stated tax balance can be shown from the roll the office already reads.
tasks.still_hard: Whether that balance affects this title, and what use it limits, stay with the examiner.
tasks.human_edge: The examiner determines the effect. A tax row does not.
tasks.altitude: The examination and the determination stay in full. Only the tax lookup and the filing of the accepted titles note are shorter.

reach.task: Read the titles note the examiner accepted
reach.learn: The searcher does not set the limit

tasks.short: List encumbrances and file the accepted reports.

steps.what: List title encumbrances encountered during searching.
Outline actions needed to clear the titles.
Accept the reports they prepare.
File the accepted reports.

tasks.design: The examiner outlines the actions needed to clear the titles and accepts the reports. {DOCS} only lists encumbrances the search index already names, then files the reports they accepted. The list does not clear the title. Nothing writes the actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: The encumbrance names were retyped into the report after the search.
tasks.enabler_now: Encumbrance names already on the search index can be listed.
tasks.still_hard: What must be done to clear the title stays with the examiner.
tasks.human_edge: The examiner outlines the actions. A list does not clear the title.
tasks.altitude: Outlining the actions and accepting the reports stay in full. Only the encumbrance list and the filing of the accepted reports are shorter.

reach.task: Read the report the examiner accepted
reach.learn: The report does not clear the title

evidence.claim: A parcel query can list instruments the register already indexes. It does not examine them.
Names and title documents are personal data. They leave only in a version the examiner has accepted.
A summary used in an examination must not add a citation the examiner did not take from the book in front of them. A line with no page is not filed.

assumptions: The workflow starts when searching has named encumbrances and ends when the accepted report is on file. The examiner outlines the actions. The list does not clear the title.
The fields are the encumbrance name, the source page, and the action they outline. The search index produces the name. The examiner produces the action. The report does not clear the title.
The prior classes this task as amplify. The steps agree the outlining stays. The list and the filing are the parts that move.
unknowns: Whether every encumbrance the examiner meets is already named on the search index.
Which actions the office refuses to put in a report until a recorded release exists.

role.altitude: The examiner still marks the search, reviews the policies, and signs before anything is issued. They still examine the documentation and the individual titles, and they still outline what would clear a title. A template, an index row, a tax figure, and a filed version are the parts that move. A system does not issue a policy.
reach: A closing party receives commitments the examiner signed
A searcher reads an examination the examiner accepted
skills_to_grow: Signing a commitment only after the search notes exist
Verifying ownership rather than trusting an index row
Outlining how a title is cleared rather than filing a list
role.ambitious_version: Every commitment that is issued is one the examiner signed, and every titles note that is filed is one they accepted.
